purpose: Russian local semantic intent understanding for auction assistant; no free-form prose generation
inference: mean pooling, normalize true, 384 dimensions; nearest example per different label
wasm_runtime: onnxruntime-web SIMD one thread under Node; not browser automation

known_false_acceptance.mitigation: Explicit destructive/money intent gate before model; proposed route only and user review; no destructive or financial model actions.

limitations: Small exploratory Russian set, not a production accuracy estimate
24/38 abstentions at fixed conservative thresholds: keep deterministic command parser first and show manual route/help choices when uncertain
Embedding classifier understands similarity; it cannot write arbitrary answers, verify facts, monitor background events or authorize transactions
Native and WASM used exactly the same quantized ONNX; GGUF language-model reports are separate and not shipped
Node WASM execution validates numerical compatibility, not Safari browser support or iPhone performance
